name: AlertDialog
description: Alert dialog: icon, title, description and an action footer on top of the dialog route. Opens over the whole app via showAlertDialog; paints the DialogTheme card shell when used inline.

fields.iconColor: ThemedColor? - header icon colour, mutedForeground token
fields.titleStyle: TextStyle? - 18px w600; colour falls back to foreground
fields.descriptionStyle: TextStyle? - 14px; colour falls back to mutedForeground
fields.iconGap: double? - null, resolves spacing.lg (16 at the default base)
fields.headerGap: double? - null, resolves spacing.sm (8, between title and description)
fields.footerGap: double? - null, resolves spacing.lg (16, between header and footer)
fields.actionGap: double? - null, resolves spacing.sm (8, between footer actions)
